text.text:
The revelation was real!
Just like our ancestors predicted!  Even if our summoning rituals weren't completed, it would still invite something.  To think our combined efforts lead the God of Magic to our plane…

To think the God of Magic would immediately descend and return life to the dead.  A miracle not even the sages of old could theorize was possible.
It's just that God is angry. Something, or someone, must have angered him.  I urge all my colleagues to seek out the wrongdoers.  Our life force is but a sacrifice for our glorious One!

Truly, it is exhillarating feeling my very own life drain and give it to the veil.  It will use it to then create new life with just the vessel of an old one!
It used to take half a circle and the vessel's entire life force to do this.  Now I can just go around and contribute to God's work.

Brothers, Sisters, all Sages of Truth.
I have found our enemy!
The Government is hiding God's gifts from us!  Illegal they call them.  An affront to nature they call them.  They even dare presume the will of God.  I tell you, spread the word.  We will gather at their hideout.  We will show them the truth!
Bring sacrifices and let's show them what our old rituals can do now!
